newsitem.title: USA: LEC Technologies signs $600,000 lease deal.
newsitem.headline: LEC Technologies signs $600,000 lease deal.

text.p: LEC Technologies Inc on Wednesday said it has signed a $600,000 agreement to lease data storage units to another technology company.

LEC said it will lease two, 360-gigabyte Amdahl Corp disk array systems to the company. LEC also agreed not to disclose the identity of the lessee. The privately owned company had multi-million dollar revenues in 1996, and employs nearly 5,000 people internationally, LEC said.
LEC, founded in 1980, specializes in the distribution and leasing of new and used computer and telecommunications equipment.
